full_judgment: 5. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of the Appellate Court, defendant Nos. 16-20 and 27-45 filed Civil Revision No. 5117 of 2004 before the High Court Division and a Single Bench by the impugned judgment and order, in spite of discharging the Rule, made some observations in the body of the judgment as to the entitlement of the plaintiffs and the defendants about their saham in the suit khatian. Against the judgment and order of the High Court Division, the plaintiffs preferred Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No, 2064 of 2008 before this Division and leave was granted giving rise to this appeal.
